What is a context graph?

Connected memory of facts, events and decisions,
with the evidence behind them.

The agent can retrieve what happened, and why.

Context graphs connect the case.

1. The facts.

Customer. Order. Applicable policy.

2. The work so far.

Case 17 already has Photo 8.

3. The decision and its basis.

The context can be small.

Memory becomes part of the loop.

Same customer.
The case continues.

The agent retrieves the evidence and approval before replying.

Questions?

One bounded query.

MATCH (o:Order {id: $orderId})<-[:ABOUT]-(c:Case)
OPTIONAL MATCH (c)-[:HAS_EVIDENCE]->(e:Evidence)
OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Decision)-[:FOR_CASE]->(c)
RETURN o, c,
       collect(DISTINCT e) AS evidence,
       collect(DISTINCT d) AS decisions
